verdict.rationale: Meltano is an ELT/data-pipeline platform, and AI-generated insights over the data it handles is a plausible ask for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows any AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. The documented features are connectors, dbt transformations, orchestration, monitoring and a CLI, none of which provide AI analysis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
